candidate_statistics.address_provenance: 771E00 builds a controller-specific request prefix00 06 13, length0x28, feature DWORD at+0x20 and controller at+0x24. On successful 376D60 return, reply DWORD+0x10 becomes controller S+0x74. Existing scalar/64-byte reads consume that base plus their offset.
candidate_statistics.separate_refresh: 772220 uses prefix00 03 05, length0x54 and returned64-byte block. The receiver and copy/latch/reset semantics remain unproved; it was not invoked.

freshness_audit.cache: 76F1D0 ignores772220status and marks the per-query cache flag valid. The helper can fail without copying data, or returnzero on an early skip without copying.
freshness_audit.direct_read: The scalar callback logs a failed30C7E0 firmware-memory read without updating its EDI status accumulator; the caller can mark the row valid.
freshness_audit.zero_qualification: A zero-initialized result can retain zero only when later host carry is absent or zero; otherwise that carry can produce a valid-looking nonzero result. Neither case independently proves freshness.
freshness_audit.scope: Pinned static control flow only; no induced firmware failure or current failing sample is claimed

normal_construction_projection.shared_source: The matched normal initialization shares chip DWORD X between constructor tuple((X>>24)&0x3F,(X>>20)&0xF) and public fields((X>>20)&0x3F0,(X>>20)&0xF). RM20801701 returns those GPU fields; public07000001 escape copies them.
normal_construction_projection.profile_selector: On this projection, RmPmuUcodeProfile zero or lookup failure uses the table descriptor, and successful4/5 explicitly selects the same descriptor. Other successful values error. This is not a recommendation to change the key.
normal_construction_projection.rewrites: The two traced V2 compatibility rewrites output170/0 or190/2 and cannot manufacture the observed1B0/3 pair.
